name: Woodland
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Woodland for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 2 (Cocoa with Santa Paws) through December 13 (Woodland Wonderland of Lights at the Yolo County Fairgrounds, December 5 to 13), with Neighborhood Santa (December 9 to 11) and the Woodland Holiday Parade on Main (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Woodland

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Woodland
  • 2 free events, including Neighborhood Santa and the Holiday Parade on Main
  • Meet Santa: Cocoa with Santa Paws at the Woodland Dog Park and Neighborhood Santa sleigh routes with Woodland Police
  • Parades: Woodland Holiday Parade on Main (December 12)
  • Season: December 2 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Woodland families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Sacramento, which covers the Polar Express train ride, Imaginarium at Cal Expo and the Nutcracker.
